Messages.Body:
I'm sorry but I can't post the 2 cards text.

Poison Pill states that the Methuselah calling the referendum LOSES the same amount of pool you LOSE for the referendum.

Ancient Influence (but also Kine resources contested or reins of power) uses the wording "burn pool".

In my opinion it's obvious that the burnt pool is lost, then poison pill works, but I 'd prefer it's crystal clear...

Messages.Author: Snodig
Messages.Body:
Poison Pill
[Reaction]
Only usable during a referendum, before votes and ballots are cast.
If the referendum passes and the effect of the referendum causes you to lose pool, the controller of the acting vampire loses the same amount of pool (in addition to the effects of the referendum).

Ancient Influence
[Political Action]
Successful referendum means each Methuselah may choose a ready vampire he or she controls. Each Methuselah gains an amount of pool from the blood bank equal to his or her chosen vampire's capacity. Each Methuselah then burns 5 pool. Only one Ancient Influence can be played in a game.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Burning pool and losing pool are the same.

Card text: the Methuselah gains pool, then burns 5 pool. (not: gains X-5 pool).

This is why you can't withdraw even if you gain pool in the end after an Ancient Influence, or if a vampire you control loses 1 blood and somehow regains it.
